mid.diary: We had a simple but heartfelt wedding.

mid.label: Hawaii
mid.diary: Honeymoon in Hawaii. The sunsets were beautiful.

low.label: Trip in Japan
low.diary: Honeymoon at a hot spring in Japan. So relaxing.

honeymoon.skip: We skipped the honeymoon. "Someday," we promised.

high.diary: We decided we'd both work full-time.

mid.diary: My partner switched to shorter hours / part-time.

low.diary: My partner left work to focus on home.

high.label: Imported car
high.diary: We bought an imported car. Driving it makes us sit up straight.

mid.label: New Japanese car
mid.diary: We bought a new Japanese car. Weekend drives became our joy.

low.label: Used car
low.diary: We bought a used car. A bit old, but it runs fine.

low.label: Grandparents
low.diary: The grandparents will look after them. They're thrilled.

mid.diary: Started at public elementary school, plus some lessons.

low.label: Public
low.diary: Started at public elementary school. The school backpack looks huge.

high.diary: Started at a private junior high.

mid.diary: Started public junior high and began cram school.

low.label: Public
low.diary: Started public junior high. Totally into club activities.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private high school.

mid.diary: Started public high school, with cram school too.

low.diary: Got into a national/public university. ({years} yrs)

high.label: Custom-built house
high.diary: We built a custom house. We talked over the floor plan again and again.

mid.label: New condo
mid.diary: We bought a new condo. We love the view from the balcony.

low.label: Used + renovation
low.diary: We bought a used house and renovated it. Old, but full of charm.

house.skip: We didn't buy; we moved to a bigger family rental.
house.never: We decided to rent for life. Traveling light is best.
house.majorRepair: The used house's plumbing and roof gave out. Major renovation cost {cost:money}.

high.label: Full renovation
high.diary: We renovated the whole house. That'll hold for a while.

low.label: Quick fix
low.diary: We patched it up for now.

high.label: Trip abroad
high.diary: We took a family trip abroad.

mid.label: Trip in Japan
mid.diary: We took a family trip within Japan.

low.label: Day trip nearby
low.diary: We went on a day trip nearby. Still fun.

familyTrip.skip: We spent this year's anniversary relaxing at home.

S.comment: No more money worries. Let's go wherever we always wanted, whenever we like.

A.comment: Hobbies and travel to enjoy. We can laugh and say, "We did well."

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. Calm days go on.

C.comment: The pension alone feels thin. We'll get by together, saving where we can.

D.comment: We'll keep working a while. While we're able, that's not so bad.

bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and our finances collapsed. Look back at where we overreached, and try again.
